    return {'capacity': {'range': 4, 'exact': 4},

def check(name, payload, invalid=True, raw=None):
    data = raw if raw is not None else json.dumps(payload, separators=(',', ':')).encode()
    out = harness.answer(data)
    bad = out.get('error') == 'invalid_request'
    status = 'OK ' if bad == invalid else 'PROBLEM '

    return bad == invalid

    payload = good()

    if not check(name, payload, invalid, raw):
        fails += 1
